children: Evolution Petroleum Corp. (EPM) filed a Form 8K - Other Events - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 15, 2026.

On September 10, 2026, the Company approved the declaration of a $0.12 per common share dividend for the first quarter of 2027 to shareholders of record on September 21, 2026 and payable on September 30, 2026.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1006655/000110465926107957/epm-20260910x8k.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1006655/000110465926107957/0001104659-26-107957-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
